key_insight: A transfer-learning model with uncertainty quantification can screen greener solvent substitutes by predicting key solubility descriptors from very limited experimental data.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, higher-throughput solvent selection for organic photovoltaics and related materials workflows, reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error experiments.
method: Pre-train on QM9 foundation targets, then transfer to solvent-property prediction with minimal new data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can rank predictions by confidence.
Build a customizable screening tool for solvent substitution and green candidate discovery.
evidence_signal: The model matches established targets like Hansen solubility parameters and dielectric constant, and also performs well on scarce-label properties such as Gutmann donor and acceptor numbers.
watch_item: Performance may depend on how well the pretraining domain and small downstream datasets cover the chemistry of the target solvents, so uncertainty should be used when extrapolating.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
